# rmux 0.1.25
More complete Settings controls, clearer terminal search, and less rendering work for hidden terminals.
- Edit terminal colors, font family, and session, socket, and history paths directly in Settings, with color swatches, native browsing, validation, and per-setting resets. - Preserve unrelated configuration edits when saving or undoing Settings changes, and report conflicts instead of overwriting them. Add clearer restart guidance and search-match explanations. - Group terminal search results by window and workspace, highlight matching excerpts, and reliably navigate to matches across windows. - Skip redundant hidden-terminal output invalidations after releasing snapshots, while retaining output and independent status/error updates. Add opt-in rendering counters and a documented CPU/memory baseline. - Make startup, socket, and session-recovery errors more actionable while preserving existing files and endpoints. Keep full diagnostics available from compact toasts. - Polish compact Settings layouts and success feedback, and add native macOS Window → Minimize / Command-M support. - Prevent live-shell smoke fixtures from stealing keyboard focus, improving repeatability of input and exit checks.
## Downloads
Signed and notarized macOS Apple Silicon DMG and ZIP, Linux x86-64 tarball, and Windows x86-64 ZIP. macOS updates use Sparkle. All release builds run on GitHub.
Validation: 320 desktop tests passed with six intentional ignores, the desktop/CLI debug build passed, and the final live-shell smoke passed all 25 checks. Native Settings and cross-window search checks passed. Render visibility checks verified retained Unicode output and fresh painting on return. Performance baselines cover 1, 8, and 32 terminals; debug measurements are not release speedup claims. Native Windows runtime validation remains deferred.
